notes: Single 15-entry current documentary candidate. semanticModel is a machine-inspectable proposed definition index tied to owning CR2–CR13 rules, NOT independently approved immutable semantic bytes, native layouts, or a trustworthy source for computing production digests. All exportStatus values stay UNVERIFIED; historic 13-entry registry/vectors remain untouched. Rule definition text has been attached to each type as an unapproved exact-content candidate; ruleId-only hashing is forbidden.

entries.semanticSummary: Exactly two logical values; candidate portable typed JSON tokens true or false only, never integer truthiness
unresolvedObligations: architect acceptance of typed JSON Bool external encoding profile

semanticRules.definition: Domain exactly {false,true}; integer, string, null and implicit truthiness conversion are invalid.
With exact Bool TypeReference, portable typed JSON is the token true or false only; numeric 0/1 and string booleans reject.

entries.semanticSummary: Immutable owned octet sequence, candidate 0..1048576 bytes; typed JSON 0x followed by even lowercase hex digits, zero length allowed
unresolvedObligations: architect approval of first-portable-value size/encoding policy in D3 CR12
native owned storage and cross-domain retain/move/cleanup proof
D5 target buffer budget qualification

semanticRules.definition: Owned immutable ordered octets, including empty; equality is length and exact octets; typed JSON is lowercase 0x prefix plus two lowercase hex digits per byte.
The proposed first portable Bytes value contains at most 1048576 decoded octets; validate size and quota with checked arithmetic before allocation.
Owned copy duplicates or safely retains immutable storage; move takes effect only after confirmed admission; rejection leaves the original owner responsible.

entries.semanticSummary: Typed immutable event occurrence; origin and generation validated by runtime; no implicit native subscription
unresolvedObligations: source event payload/provenance export binding and exact delivery proof

semanticRules.definition: Event<T> is one immutable typed occurrence with exact verified originating ViewIdentity and generation, not user-forged source metadata.
Event<T> supplies neither native subscription, OS callback, transferable Graph dataFlow nor physical provider admission permission.

entries.semanticSummary: Candidate finite IEEE-754 binary64 only, including signed zeros and subnormals; portable typed JSON bit string 0x plus exactly 16 lowercase hex digits; all exponent 0x7ff patterns reject
unresolvedObligations: architect acceptance of finite-only and bit-exact portable policy in D3 CR12
target ABI and no-flush-to-zero/subnormal preservation proof
arithmetic/rounding semantics if later exposed in source language

semanticRules.definition: F64 is finite IEEE-754 binary64 bit patterns only; reject all exponent 0x7ff patterns before native materialization.
Typed JSON F64 uses 0x plus exactly 16 lowercase hex digits encoding unsigned raw binary64 bits MSB-first; positive and negative zero have distinct bit identities.
Positive and negative finite subnormals round-trip with every bit intact; no implicit flush-to-zero, arithmetic, rounding, approximate equality or total order.

entries.semanticSummary: Finite immutable ordered owned snapshot; conditional Send, bounded by D5
unresolvedObligations: generic-instance ownership/layout proof and accepted full logical trait closure

semanticRules.definition: List<T> is a finite ordered immutable owned snapshot; changing elements makes a new revision; no asynchronously mutable borrowed backing store.
The current admitted L4 List<T> requires verified immutable nominal record T; syntactically nested generic T is not thereby authorized as an L4 value without reviewed specialization.
List<T> is Send only when T and owned immutable snapshot retention are verified Send; enforce D5 list byte/element/tree quotas and no assumed Copy.

entries.semanticSummary: Closed provider result Success(T)/Failure(E), distinct from UI request outcome
unresolvedObligations: generic-instance closure and target layout proof

semanticRules.definition: Result<T,E> represents an admitted provider terminal result, never request admission, cancellation or transport ambiguity; Success carries T, Failure carries E.
Exactly ordered closed variants Success(T) and Failure(E); a provider Result has no TaskOutcome control branches.

entries.semanticSummary: Tagged StringKey(String) or U64Key(U64), with exact tag+value equality and portable framing
unresolvedObligations: native-layout proof

semanticRules.definition: Closed union StringKey(String) and U64Key(U64); exact tag and value equality; StringKey UTF-8 byte length is 1..256 with no normalization.
Portable identity bytes: StringKey tag 0x01 + big-endian 4-byte byte length + strict UTF-8; U64Key tag 0x02 + big-endian 8-byte integer; reject invalid tags, lengths and bytes.

unresolvedObligations: native concurrency and generation proof

semanticRules.definition: StateRevision is a monotonic nonnegative counter bound to one specific UI owner and generation; cross-owner comparison or update is invalid.
StateRevision is not GraphRevision, ViewRevision, HEAD epoch, arbitrary U64 or portable Graph payload; it grants no authority to mutate another owner.

entries.semanticSummary: Immutable sequence of Unicode scalar values, exact comparison and UTF-8 portable boundary
unresolvedObligations: target-owned representation and Send proof

semanticRules.definition: String is an immutable exact Unicode scalar sequence; strict UTF-8 at boundary; embedded U+0000 is content, not native termination.
String values preserve exact scalar order without NFC, casefold, grapheme equality, invalid UTF-8 splits or borrowed StringView Send inference.

entries.semanticSummary: Five distinct UI request outcomes; provisional internal AdmissionError/ProviderError/CancellationConfirmation category rules in CR12, NOT complete portable public type exports
unresolvedObligations: approved closed portable error/control payload export definitions and digests
trusted quiescence/cancellation proof and source-to-Graph outcome linkage
generic instance closure, native tagged ABI and ownership proof

semanticRules.definition: Exactly five ordered variants: Successful(T), Failed(E), AdmissionRejected(AdmissionError), Cancelled(CancellationConfirmation), ProviderUnavailable(ProviderError); distinct from provider Result<T,E>.

AdmissionError code is one of invalid-arguments, capacity-exceeded, stale-view, capability-denied, unsupported-target with trusted no-dispatch proof. ProviderError phase never-admitted permits provider-unavailable, link-unresolved, abi-unverified, transport-failure only with no-dispatch proof; phase indeterminate-after-admission permits provider-unavailable or transport-failure only. Cancelled requires same owner/ticket/generation confirmed-quiescent proof; source cannot forge control outcomes.

Indeterminate provider admission may settle the original UI slot once as ProviderUnavailable but does not free the native ticket; no fake rollback, replay, auto retry, duplicate completion or premature disposal.

entries.semanticSummary: Opaque affine UI-owner-bound request slot, never portable persisted value
unresolvedObligations: runtime handle/lifetime proofs

semanticRules.definition: TaskSlot<T,E> is opaque affine UI-owner/generation-bound, source-declared, nonportable and forbidden as Graph/record/command dataFlow payload or native pointer.
One TaskSlot owns at most one active request ticket under the exact ViewIdentity/generation; admission, delivery, retirement and cleanup must respect the same owner.

entries.semanticSummary: Opaque affine runtime request identity, never portable persisted value
unresolvedObligations: generation/reclamation and native handle proofs

semanticRules.definition: TaskTicket is an opaque affine runtime operation identity without source constructor, Copy, portable serialization or transferable Graph payload.
Native TaskTicket ownership persists after uncertain UI settlement until authenticated provider terminal/quiescence and owner-generation cleanup.

entries.semanticSummary: Unsigned 0..4294967295; candidate typed JSON integer token, strict no exponent/leading zeroes
unresolvedObligations: architect acceptance of typed JSON U32 external encoding profile

semanticRules.definition: U32 is exactly unsigned integers 0..4294967295 without negatives, saturation, widening or implicit conversions.
Typed JSON U32 is a canonical nonnegative integer token 0..4294967295, without fraction, exponent, leading zeros or negative zero.

entries.semanticSummary: Unsigned 0..18446744073709551615; candidate typed JSON decimal string without leading zeroes, never floating-point coercion
unresolvedObligations: architect acceptance of typed JSON U64 external encoding profile

semanticRules.definition: U64 is exactly unsigned integers 0..18446744073709551615, not a floating-point approximation.
Typed JSON U64 is canonical unsigned decimal string 0 or a nonzero-leading digit sequence; signs, whitespace, exponent, JSON numeric tokens and overflow reject.

entries.semanticSummary: Single logical zero-payload value, not a native null pointer

semanticRules.definition: Unit has exactly one zero-payload inhabitant; no implicit null, missing field, boolean or provider success state.
Unit is a typed no-payload logical value, not native null pointer, uninitialized memory, cancellation token or runtime authorization.
